Requirement: Find plant running when the building is empty
Description: Flag air handlers, fan coils and chillers that run outside their schedule or with no occupancy.
Report each month's energy against what the weather and occupancy would predict.
Check that the sub-meters add up to the main incomer and flag drift.
Raise the chilled-water supply temperature when cooling demand is low.
Close the outdoor air damper towards minimum when return CO2 is low.
Warn before the month's peak demand is exceeded.

Requirement: Maintenance scheduling across the technician team
Description: Plan corrective and planned work over the week by skill, hours and due date.
Tell the cleaning team when to refill soap and towels and how much to order.
Let facility staff ask questions about live and historical data in plain language.

Requirement: Open work orders ranked by urgency
Description: Rank the open work order queue by priority and time left to the SLA.
Predict chiller failures before they happen.
Count visitors from the existing CCTV cameras.
